notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded implementation of the official 2025 C++ RTI/encoding/HLAopaqueData.h class. IEEE 1516.1 Table 27 maps HLAopaqueData to the C++ HLAopaqueData helper and VariableLengthData. IEEE 1516.2 Table 35 defines the representation as a dynamic HLAvariableArray of HLAbyte whose semantics are an uninterpreted sequence of bytes; the companion 1516.2 BasicDataElements contract separately pins the signed HLAinteger32BE element-count rule. The exact Table 27/Table 35 rows are source-checked but are not exported as immutable helper requirement candidates; RL-053 records that Requirements Lab boundary. The official C++ header's external-memory API is implemented as caller-owned borrowed storage: encoding observes caller mutations and set/decode writes only within the declared buffer. The deterministic insufficient-capacity error is an implementation safety choice required to avoid inventing allocation or ownership semantics; it is not presented as a separate standards or conformance result. This does not establish generic constructed-data encoding, an adapter surface, interoperability, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, or conformance.
